decision.explanation: The question asks for positions held 'currently or formerly'. Document 1 (D1S2, D1S4) states Samiu Vaipulu was appointed 'Senior Advisor to the President of the United States' (current/recent). Document 2 (D2S2, D2S8) states he 'currently holds the position of Deputy Prime Minister of Tonga' (current). Document 1 (D1S6) mentions he served as 'Minister of Foreign Affairs in Tonga from 2014 to 2018' (former). Document 2 (D2S5) mentions he held the position of 'Minister of Agriculture, Food, Forests, and Fisheries from 2014 to 2019' (former). All four candidates are explicitly supported by the source text as positions held by the entity. The fallible audits incorrectly flagged these as 'death_date' errors; direct inspection confirms they are valid position answers matching the query scope.
